title: Last Resort (move)
text:
The Best redirects here. For the Korean opening theme, see The Best (song).

      
Last Resort (Japanese: とっておき The Best) is a damage-dealing Normal-type move introduced in Generation IV. It can be upgraded to the special Z-Move Extreme Evoboost by Eevee holding Eevium Z.

== Effect ==
Last Resort inflicts damage and has no secondary effect. Last Resort will fail unless the Pokémon has used all of its other moves at least once while on the field. Using a move before switching out and back in does not count towards being able to use Last Resort. Last Resort will fail if it is the only move the user knows, or if the user does not know Last Resort (such as if it is called indirectly).
A move will still count as used for Last Resort even if it would have no effect, so for example, using Snore when the user is awake or a move missing due to accuracy or evasion.

=== Generation IV ===
Last Resort's power is 130.

=== Generation V onwards ===
Last Resort's power has been increased to 140.

=== Pokémon GO ===
Last Resort is a Charged Attack that has been available since August 11, 2018.


=== Pokémon Mystery Dungeon series ===
Last Resort deals damage, but will fail if the user has no moves that have 0 PP. It will multiply damage by 1.5× and 2× if 2 or 3 moves are out of PP.
